sentences.en: He had time to lose himself in his favorite amusement.
sentences.zh: 他有时间沉浸在自己最喜欢的娱乐活动中。

sentences.en: She had time to lose herself in her favorite amusement.
sentences.zh: 她有时间沉浸在自己最喜欢的娱乐活动中。

sentences.en: Yesterday, I ran into my teacher at the amusement park.
sentences.zh: 昨天我在游乐园碰到了我的老师。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：amuse（使愉快）+ment（表名词）→娱乐
